title: Start with a site.
Work through
the whole design.
intro: Panel count is only the beginning. PVsim connects site modeling, module layout, shading and generation assessment, and string checks so spatial, solar and electrical conditions can be reviewed together.
sceneLabel: Give every layout a design rationale
storyLabel: Design starts with understanding the site
story: A different layout on the same site creates a different design. Obstacles, available space and sunlight affect placement; placement in turn affects generation estimates and electrical strings.
PVsim brings these connected questions into one project: build the scene, adjust a scheme, then revisit the assumptions and checks to explain why the design makes sense.
processTitle: Turn an idea for a site
steps: Start with site boundaries and obstacles to create a shared model and establish the design limits.
Explore module arrangements, bringing shading and generation assessments back into layout decisions.
Review electrical string conditions and organize the scheme and findings for the next discussion.
capabilitiesIntro: Six areas define the PVsim product direction, from layout to design checks. A demo environment is available; calculation conditions, equipment data and delivery scope are confirmed for each project.
capabilities: Establish site and obstacle conditions so every layout begins with the same scene information.
Explore arrangements within the available space, relating placement choices to site conditions.
Bring surrounding obstructions and sunlight into the discussion to identify areas that need another look.
Read the layout alongside calculation assumptions to understand a scheme’s estimated performance and conditions.
Continue from spatial layout to string planning, reviewing module, inverter and string design conditions.
Keep design context with each project so schemes, assumptions and results can be reviewed and discussed later.
